headline: SITCON 3 (ELEVATED): OpenSSH SSHole used to breach Linux systems; GPUStack auth bypass in KEV; Qubole AWS access abused

bullets.text: SITCON rises from 4 to 3. SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158) is now the top story across 5 outlets, with attackers using it to breach Linux systems. CISA added it to KEV on 11-09 with a federal due date of 11-12.

Also added to KEV on 11-09, all due 11-12: GPUStack CVE-2026-102895 (a trusted-loopback check fooled by a reverse-proxy peer or the X-GPUStack-Real-IP header grants unauthenticated admin), SignalWire FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 (code injection) and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

Cloud trust abuse: attackers used Qubole's trusted access into customer AWS accounts to breach them and steal data, and The Register reports trusted AWS integrations being backdoored to steal secrets.

N-able has taken its cloud platform offline after more than 30 "zero-days" were published. Separately, the ARTEX toolkit has gone from pentesting tool to attacker staple in three months, including use against the banking sector.

Supply chain: Ethersphere's bee-js library and Swarm Desktop app were compromised to deliver wallet-stealing malware. 300 malicious packages were listed in the GitHub Advisory Database over the last 7 days, almost all on npm.

Breaches still developing: Iris Ohyama (7.7M), Frontline Education (3M+), Revolve (1.5M), Amplifon; new: Wyndham app data exposure, York University, Vanderbilt. France blames Iran for supermarket freezer attacks that caused fires. 7 days ran 0.83x the 90-day average.

actions: Patch OpenSSH for CVE-2026-123158 on every internet-facing host and router; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for unexpected logins.
Patch or isolate GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895), FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218) before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
Audit IAM roles that trust third-party AWS accounts; remove unused integrations such as Qubole and rotate any secrets they could reach.
N-able customers: track N-able's advisories while its cloud platform is offline and review RMM access and agent activity.
Check for bee-js or Swarm Desktop installs; if found, treat the machine as compromised and move funds from wallets used there.
Clear remaining KEV deadlines: VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (11-11), Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (11-13), SonicWall SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 (11-20).
